description: Set how actions play back (Actions panel menu > Playback Options: accelerated, step by step, or pause between steps), and toggle Button Mode or Allow Tool Recording

pauseSeconds.description: Seconds between steps, for playback pause. Default 1

toggleButtonMode.description: Switch Button Mode on or off (it toggles; the panel shows the current state)

toggleToolRecording.description: Switch Allow Tool Recording on or off (it toggles)

name: set_action_options
title: Set Action Options
